Vera Long: Noticing a small undercount on invoices for 2026-06-12 to 2026-06-13 (~15.2k tokens). Looks like a delayed ingest after a consumer failover.

Hector Alvarez: Can you paste the quick query and affected orgs?

Vera Long: SQL:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_expected)-SUM(tokens_ingested) AS gap
FROM token_ingest_summary
WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-06-12' AND '2026-06-13'
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING gap > 0;
```
Sanitized: org-61 gap=8200, org-178 gap=7300 (total ~15.5k).

ops-bot: alert: delayed-ingest detected, backlog=20h, source=consumer-group-4

Janet Park: I'll own replay + ledger backfill. Plan: dry-run replay, real replay, ledger-backfill, then hold invoice reissue until verification. ETA dry-run within 1h, full backfill by EOD.

Hector Alvarez: Owner/action list:
- [x] evidence capture (Vera) - ticket FIN-8302
- [ ] dry-run replay (Janet) - cmd+run-id to post
- [ ] ledger backfill job (Janet) - attach verification CSV
- [ ] draft credits & legal review (Vera + Legal) - draft by next day
- [ ] billing unpause after verification (Hector)

Janet Park: Dry-run output: events_to_replay=15480 projected_gap=15500 projected_time=12m. Running real replay now. job-id=consumer-replay-6302.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue paused for affected invoices (job=inv-hold-9933).

Janet Park: Replay complete. ledger-backfill scheduled job-id=ledger-backfill-8810. Verification sample uploaded to finance drive link.

Vera Long: Draft customer note: "We detected a processing delay that underreported your usage for Jun 12-13. We've corrected the ledger and issued a credit of $X. Apologies for the inconvenience." Legal: prefer 'processing delay' and include USD values.

Hector Alvarez: Billing applied credits after ledger verification. billing-bot: invoice-reissue inv-hold-9933 resumed and completed. credits_applied=true.

Vera Long: Postmortem owner: Janet Park. Recurrence items: lower delayed-ingest alert threshold, add daily ledger parity job, and add replay smoke-test in CI. Janet to publish postmortem with owners by 2026-06-18.

Janet Park: Will file postmortem and link here when done.

Vera Long: Thanks everyone, closing finance follow-up when postmortem link is posted. :thumbsup:
